description: This file implements internal graph cycle detection and management for a directed graph, including cycle detection, node and edge management, and topological reordering, as part of the Abseil synchronization internal utilities.

classes.name: Vec
classes.description: A resizable vector with inlined storage, used for internal data management.

classes.name: NodeSet
classes.description: A hash set of non-negative int32_t, used for tracking node predecessors and successors.

classes.name: PointerMap
classes.description: A hash table mapping pointers to node indices for quick lookup.

classes.name: Node
classes.description: Represents a node in the graph, including rank, version, pointers, and adjacency sets.

classes.name: Rep
classes.description: Internal representation of the GraphCycles class, holding nodes, free list, and temporary state.

methods.name: GetId
methods.description: Returns a GraphId for a given pointer, creating a new node if necessary.

methods.name: RemoveNode
methods.description: Removes a node associated with a pointer from the graph.

methods.name: Ptr
methods.description: Returns the pointer associated with a GraphId.

methods.name: HasNode
methods.description: Checks if a node exists for a given GraphId.

methods.name: HasEdge
methods.description: Checks if an edge exists between two nodes.

methods.name: RemoveEdge
methods.description: Removes an edge between two nodes.

methods.name: InsertEdge
methods.description: Inserts an edge between two nodes, updating ranks and detecting cycles.

methods.name: FindPath
methods.description: Finds a path between two nodes up to a maximum length.

methods.name: IsReachable
methods.description: Checks if one node is reachable from another.

methods.name: UpdateStackTrace
methods.description: Updates the stack trace information for a node.

methods.name: GetStackTrace
methods.description: Retrieves the stored stack trace for a node.
